seoTitle: URL Extractor from HTML: Links, Scripts, Images, CSS, JSON-LD
metaDescription: List every URL in pasted HTML: anchors, scripts, stylesheets, images, srcset, forms, meta refresh, CSS url() and JSON-LD, resolved and grouped by host.
intro: Get every URL a page references, with the tag it came from, resolved against a base URL.
why:
To audit third-party calls, migrate a site or check what a page loads, you need a list of every URL in its HTML. This extractor reads anchors, link, script, img, source, iframe and form attributes, srcset candidates, meta refresh and og:url values, CSS url() references, JSON-LD urls and plain-text URLs, resolves relative ones against the page URL and groups them by host.

It works on the HTML you paste; it will not see URLs built by JavaScript at runtime or requests made by scripts. Use the HAR analyzer for what a browser actually requested.
howTo: Set the page URL to resolve relative paths.
Read the list and the per-host counts.

faq.q: Does it find URLs added by JavaScript?
faq.a: Only those present in the pasted source. For runtime requests use a HAR export.
Yes, each absolute URL appears once with the first place it was found.
